events.text: Is that... a bit of yellow? Okay...
Ammo. I don't have a gun yet, but ammo.
+1 Rusty Gear. No idea what it crafts.
I guess that counts as yellow.
A waystone! I can see the waystone!
Stunning level. No idea where to go.
I need yellow to understand things.
The lighting in here... I need a minute.
Is my hunger bar going down? Is this a survival game now?

profile.intro: Loot goblin. Wanders off to explore everything and won't leave a single shiny thing behind.
